cases.scenario: Select a supported candidate without a method; submit, await result, then submit an additional candidate absent from the first request. Replay the first request after spending funds.
must_hold: method_use_refs can be empty
second action does not require a declared DAG
original job and action identities are reused
costs and action counts do not grow on replay
mutations: same request_id with a different candidate
same request_id with different resource limits

cases.scenario: Prepare an action, append an unrelated research method record, and submit. Separately mutate a bound endpoint or executor configuration.
must_hold: unrelated method note does not invalidate a prepared action
relevant binding change is stale before dispatch

cases.scenario: Inject a completed result with wrong units and a measured nonzero cost; separately leave execution unresolved with a reservation.
must_hold: execution completion is distinct from rejection
known failed cost remains charged
missing result stays null
unresolved reservation remains held
runtime attribution does not add the campaign cost again
declared quote is not labeled measured

cases.scenario: Write 137 committed fixture events to each of two independent logs, read in pages of 17, read an empty page, append one event, and continue.
must_hold: all events are seen exactly once during a forward read
empty page preserves the continuation position
event references distinguish logs with equal sequence numbers
cursor from a different log is rejected

cases.scenario: Replay an event; simulate action submission before consumer checkpoint persistence; fail the handler; then produce an ordinary research note from an evaluation hook.
must_hold: stable request identity survives checkpoint loss
handler version participates in processing identity
handler error does not roll back committed facts
ordinary research note is not recursively treated as an evaluation
skip and stop are representable

cases.scenario: Snapshot a custom bundle outside the built-in catalog with SKILL.md, references/evidence.md and scripts/check.py. Modify only the reference, then remove only the script.
must_hold: explicit custom reference is supported
both mutations change content identity
old snapshots remain retrievable
record replay is idempotent
claimed content_verified without verifiable bytes is rejected
content_verified does not imply observed use

cases.scenario: Try a new unpromoted method; record a hypothesis; attempt to declare an independent evaluation with diagnostic or previously exposed evidence.
must_hold: unpromoted methods can be represented and tried
hypothesis does not become an observation
independence requires validated split and lineage
released historical tests do not become unseen
